The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mazzic]] formed an '''organization'''<ref name="Gamer 3" /> that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref> and the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> A small group, the organization consisted of Mazzic himself, his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Shada D'ukal]] who hid her deadly skills behind the facade of being nothing more than Mazzic's female companion, and the crews of his [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Mazzic's personal ship was the [[Starwind-class pleasure yacht|''Starwind''-class pleasure yacht]] ''[[Distant Rainbow]]'', and he also owned two [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]], the ''[[Raptor (Preybird)|Raptor]]'' and the ''[[Skyclaw]]''.<ref name="Gamer 3" /> The Preybirds were piloted by [[Griv]] and [[Amber (smuggler)|Amber]].<ref name="TLC" />
